parsed.name: PI C-867双轴压电定位台
parsed.name_en: PI C-867 Two-Axis Piezo Positioning Stage
parsed.description: 用于控制PI C-867相关的双轴压电/纳米定位平台，可进行XY位置读取、绝对与相对移动、速度设置、伺服开关和参考初始化，常用于显微成像中的精密扫描、样品对准和纳米级定位。
parsed.description_en: A PI C-867-based two-axis piezo/nanopositioning stage used for XY position readout, absolute and relative motion, velocity setting, servo control, and reference initialization. It is typically used for precision scanning, sample alignment, and nanometer-scale positioning in microscopy.

actions.description: 启用或关闭定位台的伺服闭环控制。
actions.description_en: Enable or disable the stage's closed-loop servo control.

actions.description: 重新初始化控制器，并可选择执行参考点/参考开关校准。
actions.description_en: Reinitialize the controller and optionally perform reference-point/reference-switch calibration.

actions.description: 设置指定通道的移动速度。
actions.description_en: Set the motion velocity for the specified channel.

actions.description: 查询指定通道的移动速度。
actions.description_en: Query the motion velocity of the specified channel.

actions.description: 将指定通道移动到绝对目标位置。
actions.description_en: Move the specified channel to an absolute target position.

actions.description: 使指定通道按给定增量做相对移动。
actions.description_en: Move the specified channel by a relative increment.

actions.description: 同时将X、Y两个通道移动到目标位置。
actions.description_en: Move the X and Y channels to their target positions together.

actions.description: 读取指定通道的当前位置。
actions.description_en: Read the current position of the specified channel.

actions.description: 读取X、Y两个通道的当前位置。
actions.description_en: Read the current positions of the X and Y channels.

actions.description: 查询控制器是否已准备好接受运动控制命令。
actions.description_en: Query whether the controller is ready to accept motion-control commands.

actions.description: 查询指定通道的对象/通道信息。
actions.description_en: Query the object or channel information associated with the specified channel.

actions.description: 查询指定通道的相位或阶段状态信息。
actions.description_en: Query phase or stage-status information for the specified channel.

actions.description: 查询指定通道允许的最小位置。
actions.description_en: Query the minimum allowed position for the specified channel.

actions.description: 查询指定通道允许的最大位置。
actions.description_en: Query the maximum allowed position for the specified channel.
